description: This file implements the ApplicationManagementServer class, which manages IPC communication for application management in the Rialto server. It handles server initialization, client connection management, event sending, and disconnection handling.

classes.name: ApplicationManagementServer
classes.description: Manages IPC communication for application lifecycle events, including initialization, event notification, and disconnection handling.

methods.name: ApplicationManagementServer::initialize
methods.description: Initializes the IPC server with a socket, sets up the client, and exports the service.

methods.name: ApplicationManagementServer::sendStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Sends a state change event to the connected IPC client.

methods.name: ApplicationManagementServer::start
methods.description: Starts the IPC server processing loop in a separate thread.

methods.name: ApplicationManagementServer::stop
methods.description: Stops the IPC client connection if connected.

methods.name: ApplicationManagementServer::onClientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles client disconnection events, logging the disconnection.
